body: Pinaka-useful boundary dito: after an investment loss, gumawa ng temporary zero-payment rule for any unsolicited ‘recovery’ contact. Hindi ibig sabihin na hopeless na ang legitimate recovery; ibig sabihin lang, walang second transfer habang hindi independently verified through an official channel na ikaw mismo ang naghanap. Maganda rin na may second person na walang financial stake na tumingin bago magbayad. Kapag urgency, secrecy, o bagong investment ang condition para raw mabawi ang luma, slowing down is the action—not another payment.

claims.text: A temporary no-payment rule plus independent verification is a proportionate household control after an investment loss because it interrupts the secondary-scam pattern described by the Consumer Affairs Agency.
claims.basis: Risk-control inference based on the article's official scam pattern.
